ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) background with high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal margins and a vertical streak in the left lobe; macro ratio estimated at 15% high-intensity to 85% low-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous blobs concentrated on the lateral tips; a distinct vertical high-contrast streak located in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe; subtle grey mottling across the central fluke body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior vertex angle of 45 degrees; bounding-box depth occupies approximately 15% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitudes vary from 2-4 pixels on the left lobe to 10+ pixels on the jagged inner margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a smooth convex sweep toward the tip; right lobe displays a truncated, more linear trajectory with a sharp vertical drop-off at the distal margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, circular white pixel clusters localized heavily on the far left tip and the outer margin of the right lobe; isolated white spots scattered along the leading edge margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent vertical linear disruption in the left lobe; multiple faint, parallel horizontal rake-like marks visible on the dark pigmented area of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue irregularity/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive barnacle encrustation on both distal ends.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced irregular 'sawtooth' profile on the right lobe's inner trailing edge; unique white vertical streaking originating from the basal region of the left lobe.
